name: snout
description: Better context for coding agents, carried across sessions: keeps bulky reads and output out of context, keeps a local, searchable record of past work, and shows what each session spent.

character.title: Show Snout
character.description: Animate Snout above the prompt until the first message of each session, and flick a tongue after the spinner word. /snout off turns it off.

pinkTheme.title: Snout Pink theme
pinkTheme.description: Switch to the Snout Pink theme once, keeping the theme it replaced. Turn off to put that theme back.
